summary: BBVA filed a 6-K reporting the execution of the third tranche of its share buyback program, disclosing transactions between May 11-15, 2026. The cash amount deployed so far in this tranche is €218.5 million, representing 14.97% of the maximum cash amount allocated. The program is being managed by Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG. This is a continuation of buybacks announced in inside information notices on Dec 19, 2025 and Apr 30, 2026. Watch for further updates on the pace and completion of the remaining buyback authorization, with potential impact on share price support and EPS accretion.
